stack.motion: Motion (formerly Framer Motion) — layout + page transitions only

routes.purpose: Operator home — at-a-glance state of the world: how many buyers, how many deals, what's flagged.
primary_data: Memo count (read from obsidian-vault/03-Deals/memos/draft/*.md, excluding status: rejected|retracted)
routes.loading_strategy: server — read filesystem via async server component; revalidate on each request (no cache); pass plain JSON to client components
routes.empty_state_design: If 0 buyers → CTA card 'Run buyer-profiler'. If 0 deals → CTA card 'Run Phase 3 discovery with search rubric'. If all deals are rejected/retracted (current state) → muted 'No actionable candidates today' card with a breakdown of why (rejection reasons grouped), plus link to RUN-LOG entry. Never show 0 charts; show the skeleton with a 'No data yet' overlay instead.

routes.purpose: Single buyer profile — capital, operator, geography, industry preferences, deal constraints. Read-only view (editing buyer profile is a subagent job, not a UI job).
routes.loading_strategy: server — single JSON read; static-ish (cache: force-cache with tag, revalidated on subagent commit hook later)
routes.empty_state_design: If buyer file missing → 404 page with 'Buyer not yet profiled — see Phase 1' message + link back to /. If scoring_weights_override is empty → render with 'using default weights' badge, no error.

routes.purpose: All deals — filterable + sortable table. The buyer's daily working surface.
primary_data: Join of ListingPacket × DealAssessment × DueDiligencePacket on listing_id
Includes rejected + retracted (with a default filter that hides them)
routes.loading_strategy: server (initial table data) + client (sort/filter state via URL search params). Sorting is client-side; data set is small (< 100 rows for foreseeable future).
routes.empty_state_design: If 0 ListingPackets → 'No listings ingested yet — paste URLs into inputs/listings.json and run Phase 3' empty card with copy-paste snippet. If all listings are rejected/retracted (current state with 8 listings, 0 actionable) → table still renders all 8 rows but with a banner: '8 listings ingested; 0 currently actionable. Toggle Show rejected to review the discard reasons.' Toggle defaults ON when actionable count is zero so the user sees something.

routes.purpose: Single deal — listing fields, diligence claims, scored assessment, and memo (if any) on one page. The 'do I send the NDA?' surface.
routes.loading_strategy: server — four file reads in parallel; suspense boundary per panel so a missing diligence packet doesn't block the listing facts panel
routes.empty_state_design: If DealAssessment missing → 'Not yet scored' banner. If DueDiligencePacket missing → 'Diligence pending' empty panel with a 'Why?' tooltip. If status: rejected → top-of-page retraction notice with reason + retrieved_at. If broker-pattern flag is set (asking/SDE < 1.5×) → red top banner 'Broker-pattern flag — confirm asking-price field with broker before any NDA' citing search-rubric §Broker patterns.

routes.purpose: Validated skills directory — read-only browser of obsidian-vault/01-Skills/ by category. Lets the buyer (or a future collaborator) see what tools the platform has under the hood.
primary_data: Skill notes (36 today) grouped by category: accounting | legal | underwriting | ui | animation | research | automation
routes.loading_strategy: server — read all 01-Skills/**/*.md frontmatter at request time; no client fetching
routes.empty_state_design: If a category has 0 skills → show the category header with a 'No skills in this category yet' note (not hidden — visible absence is signal).

routes.purpose: Single memo, printable and shareable. The buyer's 'send this to my advisor' surface.
routes.loading_strategy: server — render markdown to HTML at request time (mdx or remark). Print-optimized CSS via @media print.
routes.empty_state_design: If memo not found → 404. If memo status: retracted → top-of-document retraction banner with the retraction date + reason, body still readable below for audit.

components.name: GlobalNav
components.purpose: Top-of-page navigation, present on every route. Houses the /portfolio link-out.
components.accessibility_notes: Skip-to-main-content link as first focusable element. Active route marked with aria-current=page. /portfolio link uses rel=noopener and an external-link icon with aria-label='Portfolio app (opens in new tab)'.

components.name: StatBlock
components.purpose: Single big number with label and optional trend delta. Used 3-6× on /.
components.props_shape: { label: string; value: number|string; sublabel?: string; trend?: { delta: number; direction: 'up'|'down'|'flat' }; tone?: 'neutral'|'warn'|'positive' }
components.accessibility_notes: Numbers wrapped in <span aria-label> with full prose ('eight listings, three rejected'). Trend direction conveyed by icon + text, not color alone.
components.motion_notes: On mount: opacity 0→1, 120ms ease-out. No count-up animation (count-up is showcase territory).

components.name: BuyerCard
components.purpose: Compact summary of a BuyerProfile — name/id, capital headline, geography, top constraints. Links to /buyers/[id].
components.props_shape: { buyer: BuyerProfile; dealCount: number; memoCount: number }
components.accessibility_notes: Card is a single link (whole-card click target ≥ 44×44 px). Card semantics: <article> with aria-labelledby pointing at the buyer name h3.
components.motion_notes: Hover: subtle border-color shift, 80ms. No translate or scale (no novelty motion in core data view).

components.name: DealRibbon
components.purpose: Horizontal scrolling list of the top 5 active deals on /. Each item is a mini ScoreBadge + listing summary.
components.props_shape: { deals: Array<{ listingId: string; businessName: string; score: number; confidence: number; status: string }>; emptyMessage?: string }
components.accessibility_notes: Horizontal list is a <ul role=list>. Keyboard: arrow keys move focus between items. Tab moves focus out of the ribbon to the next region.
components.motion_notes: Spring-physics on layout reorder when filter changes (Motion's <Reorder> primitive); duration ≤ 200ms.

components.name: DealsTable
components.purpose: The primary data surface for /deals. Sortable, filterable, paginated (client-side). High information density.
components.props_shape: { rows: DealRow[]; initialSort?: { column: string; direction: 'asc'|'desc' }; initialFilters?: Record<string,unknown> }
components.accessibility_notes: Real <table> markup with <thead>/<tbody>; sortable column headers are <button> children with aria-sort. Row-level checkboxes have aria-label tied to the listing's business name. Filter changes announce via aria-live=polite region 'showing N of M deals.'
components.motion_notes: Row reorder on sort: Motion layout animation, spring stiffness ~300, damping ~30, capped at 220ms. Disabled when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: DealsFilterBar
components.purpose: Filter chips for /deals: status, hard-gate result, score range, confidence range, industry, geography, broker.
components.props_shape: { filters: FilterState; onChange: (next: FilterState) => void; activeCount: number; totalCount: number }
components.accessibility_notes: Each filter labelled with <label htmlFor>. Slider has aria-valuemin/max/now and a text-input shadow for keyboard precision. Clear-all button always present when activeCount > 0.
components.motion_notes: Chip remove: opacity 1→0 + width collapse, 150ms ease-out.

components.name: ScoreBadge
components.purpose: Numeric deal score (0–100) with tone band (red <40, amber 40-59, green 60-79, emerald 80+).
components.accessibility_notes: Tone bands echoed in text ('score 58, amber band') for screen readers and color-blind users. Color is supportive, not load-bearing.

components.name: HardGateBadge
components.purpose: Pass/fail/unknown indicator for the three hard gates (target_owner_profit, financing_feasibility, license_transferability).
components.accessibility_notes: Icon + abbreviation + tooltip with full gate description. Fail = solid red fill + ✗ icon + 'FAIL' text; pass = outlined green + ✓ icon + 'PASS'. Triple-encoded (color + icon + text).

components.name: StatusBadge
components.purpose: Listing/deal status: accepted | accepted-with-flags | rejected | speculative | retracted.
components.accessibility_notes: Status text is always visible (not icon-only). Reason exposed via Tooltip + aria-describedby.

components.name: ConfidenceMeter
components.purpose: 0.00–1.00 confidence value rendered as a 4-segment meter (0–0.25, 0.25–0.5, 0.5–0.75, 0.75–1.0).
components.accessibility_notes: role=meter with aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=1, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext='confidence 0.55 (low-medium)'.
components.motion_notes: On value change: width transition 180ms ease-out.

components.name: HardGateSummaryChart
components.purpose: Recharts stacked bar — pass/fail/unknown counts across the three hard gates. Lives on /.
components.accessibility_notes: Recharts SVG wrapped in <figure> with <figcaption>. role=img + aria-label summarizing the chart in prose. A visually-hidden <table> below the chart provides the same data for screen readers (accessibility pattern documented in plan §Accessibility).
components.motion_notes: Recharts default animation disabled (isAnimationActive=false) to honor prefers-reduced-motion globally and to avoid noisy re-paints.

components.name: DealsDistributionChart
components.purpose: Recharts histogram of deal scores. Lives on /deals.
components.accessibility_notes: Same pattern as HardGateSummaryChart — figure + figcaption + hidden data table.

components.name: ScoreBreakdownChart
components.purpose: Recharts horizontal bar — six subscores (cash_flow_fit, operator_fit, geography_fit, industry_fit, deal_structure_fit, diligence_risk). Lives on /deals/[id].
components.accessibility_notes: Same figure+caption+hidden-table pattern. Each bar's tooltip is keyboard-reachable (focusable rect).

components.name: DiligenceClaimsList
components.purpose: Grouped list of DueDiligencePacket.claims by category (registry, court, reviews, news, licensing, operator-track-record, competitive-density, regulatory, owned-web-presence).
components.accessibility_notes: Accordion uses shadcn's Radix-backed primitive — keyboard nav and ARIA already correct. Each claim's source_url opens in new tab with aria-label including the domain.
components.motion_notes: Accordion expand: 180ms height transition, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: RedFlagsList
components.purpose: Bullet list of DueDiligencePacket.red_flags, visually prominent.
components.accessibility_notes: role=region with aria-labelledby='red-flags-heading'. Empty state: 'No red flags surfaced (yet)' — empty is signal, do not hide.

components.name: FollowUpActionsList
components.purpose: Checklist of DueDiligencePacket.follow_up_actions.
components.accessibility_notes: Checkboxes are advisory (state is not persisted in v1) — labelled clearly with 'planned action, not tracked' helper text so users don't assume the checkmark saves.

components.name: MemoPanel
components.purpose: Inline preview of a memo body on /deals/[id], with a 'Open in full' link to /memos/[id].
components.props_shape: { memoMarkdown: string; memoId: string; status: string }
components.accessibility_notes: Memo body rendered with semantic markdown — h2/h3/p/ul, not div soup. Headings start at h3 (the card itself is h2).

components.name: EntityAdvisoryPanel
components.purpose: If an EntityAdvisory packet exists for this deal, render the options_considered list with a clear 'human sign-off required' callout.
components.accessibility_notes: Sign-off callout uses Alert with role=note + variant='warning' (high-contrast). Says 'Workflow-opinionated, not legally final — see signoff_checklist_path' verbatim.

components.name: BrokerPatternFlag
components.purpose: Top-of-page warning banner when a deal is associated with a broker pattern (e.g., Donald Webster / sub-1.5× SDE). Cites search-rubric-buyer-001.md §Broker patterns.
components.accessibility_notes: role=alert is too aggressive (it interrupts SR users); use role=region + aria-label='Broker pattern warning'. High contrast, icon + text.

components.name: RetractionNotice
components.purpose: Banner shown when a listing/assessment/memo has been retracted. Renders reason + retrieved_at + link to the RUN-LOG entry.
components.props_shape: { retractedAt: string; reason: string; runLogAnchor?: string }
components.accessibility_notes: Visible top-of-document. Strikethrough on heading is decorative only; the word 'RETRACTED' appears in the banner.

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: Reusable empty-state card with title, body, optional CTA. Used on every list view.
components.props_shape: { title: string; body: string; cta?: { label: string; href: string }; tone?: 'neutral'|'positive'|'warn' }
components.accessibility_notes: Empty states are <section aria-labelledby> with a real heading, not a passive 'no data' div. Tone never relies on color alone.

components.name: RecentActivityFeed
components.purpose: Last 5 entries from RUN-LOG.md parsed as a feed: date + phase + headline. Lives on /.
components.props_shape: { entries: Array<{ date: string; phase: string; headline: string; anchor: string }> }
components.accessibility_notes: role=feed with aria-busy during refresh. Each article has aria-posinset/aria-setsize.

components.name: SkillCard
components.purpose: Skill note tile for /skills. Title, category, license badge, confidence meter, source URL.
components.props_shape: { skill: { id: string; title: string; category: string; license: string; confidence: number; source_url: string; status: string; tags: string[] } }
components.accessibility_notes: License badge has aria-label that expands SPDX shorthand (e.g., 'MIT License').

motion_budget.rationale: This is the utilitarian app. Motion is for layout-reorder readability and gentle page transitions, not delight. Per OPERATING-RULES.md §4: 'No heavy motion in core data views. R3F / Spline / heavy GSAP live in apps/portfolio/, not apps/dashboard/.'
allowed_patterns: Page transition fade (opacity 0→1, 150ms ease-out) on App-Router segment changes
Layout reorder spring on DealsTable sort (Motion's layout prop, stiffness ~300, damping ~30, capped at 220ms)
Hover micro-interaction on cards and rows (border-color, 80ms)
forbidden_patterns: Decorative continuous loops (gradients, marquees, ambient backgrounds)
Recharts default animations (isAnimationActive must be false)
motion_budget.prefers_reduced_motion_strategy: Single global hook (useReducedMotion from Motion) wired in the root layout. When reduce is true: all Motion transitions become duration: 0; layout reorders snap; accordion height transitions disabled (instant open/close); hover effects remain (color only, no transform).

accessibility_notes: Target: WCAG 2.2 AA across all 6 routes. AAA where cheap (e.g., contrast > 7:1 for body text on neutral backgrounds).
Color contrast: body text ≥ 4.5:1, large text ≥ 3:1, UI components and graphical objects ≥ 3:1. Status colors (red/amber/green/emerald) are sampled to meet 4.5:1 on both light and dark surfaces.
Color is never load-bearing. Every status conveyed by color is also conveyed by text and icon (HardGateBadge: color + ✓/✗ + 'PASS'/'FAIL'; ScoreBadge: color + numeric + tone-band-name in aria-label).

Keyboard navigation: every interactive element reachable by Tab in DOM order; focus rings always visible (Tailwind ring-2 ring-offset-2, never outline:none without a replacement); skip-to-main-content link as first focusable element on every page.

Recharts accessibility (the load-bearing one — Recharts SVG is not accessible by default): every chart wrapped in <figure> with <figcaption> describing the chart in one prose sentence; role=img on the SVG with aria-label summarizing the data; a visually-hidden <table> sibling renders the same data for screen reader and keyboard users; chart tooltips are keyboard-focusable (Recharts cursor + activeIndex driven from keyboard handlers on the wrapper).

Tables: real <table>/<thead>/<tbody>/<th scope> markup; sortable headers are <button> children with aria-sort='ascending'|'descending'|'none'; aria-live='polite' region announces 'showing N of M deals' on filter/sort change.
Forms (filter inputs only in v1): every input has a visible <label htmlFor>; required fields marked with aria-required; error messages tied via aria-describedby.

Empty/loading/error states: every list view has all three. Loading uses skeleton with role=status + aria-label='loading deals'. Empty uses a real heading + body + optional CTA. Error uses Alert with role=alert (this one we DO interrupt for).
Motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce honored globally via useReducedMotion; no auto-play, no infinite loops, no flashing > 3Hz.
Touch targets: minimum 44×44 px for all interactive elements per WCAG 2.5.5 (AAA but cheap).
Heading hierarchy: one h1 per page (route title); h2 for top-level regions; h3 for cards; no skipping levels.
Page titles: <title> per route follows pattern '<Route Name> — BQA Dashboard' so browser tabs and history are scannable.

Skill availability flag: web-accessibility and web-design-guidelines Tier-2 skills are documented in 01-Skills/ but NOT installed in the sandbox session that produced this plan. The principles above are applied from first-principles WCAG 2.2 + ARIA Authoring Practices Guide. dashboard-builder should re-run a lint pass with those skills active locally before declaring GATE 4.

aesthetic_direction_summary.voice: Operational, not promotional. The buyer is data-skeptical and capital-constrained; the UI's job is to earn trust by showing the math, the sources, and the gaps. No hero copy, no marketing voice, no 'AI-aesthetic word soup.'
aesthetic_direction_summary.palette: Neutral slate (zinc-50 → zinc-950) with a single semantic accent (Atlanta-clay terracotta hsl(15 65% 48%)) for primary CTAs only. Status colors: rose-600 (fail/rejected), amber-600 (caution/flag), emerald-600 (pass/positive), sky-600 (info). All sampled to meet AA contrast on both light and dark surfaces.
aesthetic_direction_summary.typography: Sans-only. Inter (variable) for everything. Scale: 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 / 24 / 32 (no 48+ in dashboard — that's portfolio territory). Tabular numerals (font-feature-settings: 'tnum') on every number cell in tables and stat blocks.
aesthetic_direction_summary.density: Compact-by-default tables (row height 36-40 px). Generous (24-32 px) gutter on cards. The buyer is on a laptop researching deals; we optimize for rows-per-viewport without sacrificing the 44 px touch target on actual hit areas.
aesthetic_direction_summary.dark_mode: First-class. Same palette, inverted. Persisted via shadcn's theme provider, defaults to system.
